name: 21666 · Stevensville, MD
findings: ZIP 21666 (Stevensville) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21666 (Stevensville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21666 (Stevensville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
